entities.name: Ekundu Mountains
entities.description: Highest mountain range in Jamuraa on Dominaria, home to dwarves and griffins.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: Northern land that marched against the dwarves of Ekundu.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: Southern land bordered by the mountains.

entities.name: Terorq
entities.description: Femeref town to which the dwarves were forced.

entities.name: Talruum Mountains
entities.description: Range branching northwest from the Ekundu.

entities.name: Teremko Mountains
entities.description: Range branching southwest from the Ekundu.

entities.name: Kitu Mountains
entities.description: Mineral-rich small range branching from the central south.

entities.name: Jotoka Mountains
entities.description: Range branching southeast that was mined.

events.summary: Suq'Ata marches against the dwarves of Ekundu and forces them south into the Femeref town of Terorq.
events.quote: Suq’Ata marched against the dwarven denizens of Ekundu and forced them southwards
